output.hpp / output.cpp — Result Printing

On this page

  • Overview

  • Functions

Overview

Pretty-printing functions that format and display molecular geometry, basis set information, and SCF results to stdout using box-drawing Unicode characters.

Header: include/output.hpp Source: src/output.cpp

Functions

void print_molecule(const Molecule &mol)

Prints a formatted geometry table showing each atom’s symbol, atomic number, and Cartesian coordinates in both Bohr and Ångströms.

Example output:

╔═══════════════════════════════════════════════╗
║               Molecular Geometry              ║
╠═══════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║  Atom    Z        X (Bohr)    Y (Bohr)    Z (Bohr) ║
╠═══════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║   O      8      0.000000    0.000000    0.222517 ║
║   H      1      0.000000    1.430901   -0.890067 ║
║   H      1      0.000000   -1.430901   -0.890067 ║
╠═══════════════════════════════════════════════╣
║  Charge: 0   Multiplicity: 1   Electrons: 10  ║
╚═══════════════════════════════════════════════╝
void print_basis_info(const BasisSet &bs, const Molecule &mol)

Prints a summary of the loaded basis set: number of shells, total number of basis functions, and a per-element shell breakdown.

void print_rhf_result(const RHFResult &res, const Molecule &mol, const BasisSet &bs)
Parameters:

  • res – Converged (or attempted) RHF result.

  • mol – Molecule (needed for \(E_\text{nuc}\)).

  • bs – Basis set (needed to determine occupied/virtual boundary).

Prints:

  • Convergence status and number of iterations.

  • Electronic, nuclear-repulsion, and total energies.

  • Orbital energy table (up to first 20 MOs) with occupation.

  • HOMO energy, LUMO energy, and HOMO-LUMO gap.

Example energy block:

╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║          RHF Results             ║
╠══════════════════════════════════╣
║  Converged:   YES  Iterations: 12 ║
║  E_elec :   -84.1978 Ha          ║
║  E_nuc  :     9.1806 Ha          ║
║  E_total:   -75.0172 Ha          ║
╠══════════════════════════════════╣
║  HOMO :  -0.3971 Ha              ║
║  LUMO :   0.5758 Ha              ║
║  Gap  :   0.9729 Ha              ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝
void print_uhf_result(const UHFResult &res, const Molecule &mol, const BasisSet &bs)
Parameters:

  • res – Converged (or attempted) UHF result.

  • mol – Molecule.

  • bs – Basis set.

All output of print_rhf_result() plus:

  • Separate alpha and beta orbital energy tables.

  • \(\langle\hat{S}^2\rangle_\text{exact}\) and \(\langle\hat{S}^2\rangle_\text{UHF}\).

  • A spin-contamination warning if

    \[\langle\hat{S}^2\rangle_\text{UHF} - \langle\hat{S}^2\rangle_\text{exact} > 0.1 \cdot \langle\hat{S}^2\rangle_\text{exact}.\]
